name: Connor Leahy
bio: Connor Leahy is a German-American AI researcher and entrepreneur who co-founded EleutherAI in 2020 and the AI safety company Conjecture in 2022. Leahy led Conjecture as CEO until 2026 and is now US Director of ControlAI, a nonprofit focused on extinction risk from superintelligent AI.
known_for: Co-founding EleutherAI and its early GPT-Neo and GPT-J models
Founding Conjecture, an AI alignment company
Public advocacy on advanced AI risk
